lines.zh: 金发的贝吉特踏着光走
lines.en: The golden-haired Vegetto walks in light.

lines.zh: 他的头发竖起，随气流动
lines.en: His hair stands up, stirred by his aura.

lines.zh: 脚下的草被气浪压弯
lines.en: Grass bends flat under his pressure.

lines.zh: 他每走一步，空气都颤
lines.en: The air shivers at every stride.

lines.zh: 电弧在他身边细碎地跳
lines.en: Tiny arcs of lightning skip around him.

lines.zh: 他走得很稳，像在散步
lines.en: He walks steadily, almost casually.

lines.zh: 金色的气拖在身后
lines.en: A golden trail of ki drags behind.

lines.zh: 他抬手拨开空气里的火星
lines.en: He brushes sparks out of the air.

lines.zh: 他绕行时几乎不踩出声
lines.en: He circles without making a sound.

lines.zh: 他的身形偶尔闪一下
lines.en: His outline flickers now and then.

lines.zh: 他走近，热风先到
lines.en: The hot wind arrives before he does.

lines.zh: 他停在最佳的距离上
lines.en: He stops at exactly the right range.

lines.zh: 金发的贝吉特悬空半寸
lines.en: He hovers half a block off the ground.

lines.zh: 他的气焰一层层往上冒
lines.en: His aura climbs in layers.

lines.zh: 电弧绕着肩头打转
lines.en: Arcs circle his shoulders.

lines.zh: 他闭眼，气息变得极细
lines.en: He closes his eyes; his ki thins to a thread.

lines.zh: 他抬手，看了看自己的掌心
lines.en: He looks at his own palm.

lines.zh: 他的眉骨在光下很硬
lines.en: His brow looks hard in that light.

lines.zh: 他活动了一下脖子
lines.en: He rolls his neck once.

lines.zh: 金发末梢飘得很慢
lines.en: The tips of his hair drift slowly.

lines.zh: 他握拳，指缝间漏出光
lines.en: Light leaks between his clenched fingers.

lines.zh: 他站在原地，气场却在前压
lines.en: He stands still, yet his presence pushes forward.

lines.zh: 他吐出一口白气
lines.en: He exhales a plume of hot breath.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸把尘土推成波纹
lines.en: His breath pushes dust into rings.

lines.zh: 他忽然收住全部气息
lines.en: Then he draws every trace of ki in.

lines.zh: 一瞬的安静比喧嚣更重
lines.en: That hush weighs more than the noise.

lines.zh: 那双绿眼穿过气焰看着你
lines.en: Green eyes look at you through the aura.

lines.zh: 他的目光只停了一秒
lines.en: His gaze rests on you for a second.

lines.zh: 他偏头，金发跟着一晃
lines.en: He tilts his head; golden hair sways.

lines.zh: 他衡量你，像衡量一粒尘
lines.en: He weighs you like a grain of dust.

lines.zh: 他的嘴角牵了一下
lines.en: One corner of his mouth moves.

lines.zh: 他抬手，指尖还带着电弧
lines.en: He lifts a hand, arcs still crawling on it.

lines.zh: 他往前半步，热浪扑面
lines.en: Half a step closer, and heat hits your face.

lines.zh: 他把气收敛，给你留余地
lines.en: He reins his aura in, leaving you room.

lines.zh: 他的眼里没有轻蔑，只有判断
lines.en: No contempt, only assessment.

lines.zh: 他点点头，像确认了什么
lines.en: He nods, as if confirming something.

lines.zh: 他抬手示意你别紧张
lines.en: He gestures for you not to tense up.

lines.zh: 他看你时，电弧停了一瞬
lines.en: As he looks, the arcs pause.

lines.zh: 他把你放在心外的位置
lines.en: He files you outside his concern.

lines.zh: 他的声音压得很低
lines.en: His voice comes out very low.

lines.zh: 他退了一步，把路让出来
lines.en: He steps back and clears the path.

lines.zh: 他评估完，气息重新张开
lines.en: Assessment done, his aura opens again.

lines.zh: 他侧头，等你先动
lines.en: He waits, head cocked, for you to move.

lines.zh: 他的目光里有一点赞许
lines.en: There is a flicker of approval there.

lines.zh: 金发一晃，他退了半步
lines.en: His golden hair sways as he gives half a step.

lines.zh: 他的气焰瞬间缩了一下
lines.en: His aura shrinks for an instant.

lines.zh: 电弧乱了，又立刻归位
lines.en: The arcs scatter, then snap back.

lines.zh: 他抬手按住伤处
lines.en: He presses a hand to the wound.

lines.zh: 他吐出一口气，神色变冷
lines.en: He exhales and his face goes cold.

lines.zh: 他眯眼，重新估算你
lines.en: He squints and revalues you.

lines.zh: 衣角被撕开一道口子
lines.en: A corner of his clothing tears.

lines.zh: 他退了半步，又浮回原位
lines.en: He drops back, then floats in again.

lines.zh: 他笑了一下，笑意不见了
lines.en: He smiles, and there is no humour in it.

lines.zh: 他的气息重新收紧成一线
lines.en: His ki draws back into a thread.

lines.zh: 他扫了一眼你手里的东西
lines.en: He glances at the item in your hands.

lines.zh: 他接过来，看都不看就放下
lines.en: He takes it and sets it down unread.

lines.zh: 金发下他挑了挑眉
lines.en: One brow lifts beneath the gold.

lines.zh: 他摇头，气焰晃了一下
lines.en: He shakes his head; the aura ripples.

lines.zh: 他摆了摆手，意思是不必
lines.en: A wave of the hand: no need.

lines.zh: 他随手收下，算是领情
lines.en: He pockets it, accepting the gesture.

lines.zh: 他对食物毫无兴趣
lines.en: Food means nothing to him now.

lines.zh: 他把东西递还给你
lines.en: He hands it back to you.

lines.zh: 他笑了一声，很短
lines.en: A short laugh, and no more.

lines.zh: 他的注意力根本不在那上面
lines.en: His attention was never on it.

lines.zh: 你撞上他的气墙，被弹回
lines.en: You hit his aura wall and bounce back.

lines.zh: 他纹丝不动，只有电弧一跳
lines.en: He does not budge; an arc jumps.

lines.zh: 他抬手把你轻轻托住
lines.en: He catches you with an easy hand.

lines.zh: 他的气焰烫了你一下
lines.en: His aura gives you a brief burn.

lines.zh: 他侧身，像风一样让开
lines.en: He slips aside like wind.

lines.zh: 他的肩膀把你碰退两步
lines.en: His shoulder puts you two steps back.

lines.zh: 他被撞后，脚下浮起半寸
lines.en: Struck, he rises half a block.

lines.zh: 他落地时没有半点声音
lines.en: He lands without a sound.

lines.zh: 他的金发扫过你的手臂
lines.en: His golden hair brushes your arm.

lines.zh: 他稳稳站定，等你再动
lines.en: He settles and waits for you again.

lines.zh: 金发的他和同伴并肩悬空
lines.en: He and his partner hover side by side.

lines.zh: 两股气焰慢慢叠在一起
lines.en: Two auras slowly overlap.

lines.zh: 他们的动作几乎同时
lines.en: Their motions come almost together.

lines.zh: 他把手放在对方肩上
lines.en: He sets a hand on his partner's shoulder.

lines.zh: 电弧在两人之间来回跳
lines.en: Arcs leap back and forth between them.

lines.zh: 他们背靠背，各守一面
lines.en: Back to back, each guards a side.

lines.zh: 他收敛气焰，免得伤到对方
lines.en: He damps his aura so it will not burn them.

lines.zh: 他们的呼吸合成了一个
lines.en: Their breathing becomes one rhythm.

lines.zh: 他们对视，不需要言语
lines.en: They look at each other; no words needed.

lines.zh: 这一刻连电弧都安静了
lines.en: Even the arcs go quiet now.

lines.zh: 他伸手一抓，东西飞过来
lines.en: He reaches out and the item flies to him.

lines.zh: 他捏着看了看，收进衣内
lines.en: He inspects it briefly and pockets it.

lines.zh: 他用气把东西托到眼前
lines.en: His ki floats the item up to eye level.

lines.zh: 他随手扔给身后的同伴
lines.en: He tosses it back to his partner.

lines.zh: 他捏碎不想要的东西
lines.en: What he does not want, he crushes.

lines.zh: 他拾起时脚尖都没落地
lines.en: He picks it up without touching down.

lines.zh: 他把战利品压扁收好
lines.en: He flattens the prize and stows it.

lines.zh: 他看了一眼，笑了下
lines.en: One look, and a small laugh.

lines.zh: 他把东西抛上半空又接住
lines.en: He tosses it up and catches it.

lines.zh: 收好之后，气息重新张开
lines.en: Stowed, his aura opens out again.

lines.zh: 金色气焰猛地炸开
lines.en: The golden aura bursts wide.

lines.zh: 电弧一瞬间多了好几倍
lines.en: The arcs multiply in an instant.

lines.zh: 他抬头，眼睛变成冷绿
lines.en: He lifts his head, eyes cold green.

lines.zh: 地面以他为中心裂开
lines.en: The ground cracks outward from him.

lines.zh: 他抬起一只手，掌心朝你
lines.en: One palm turns toward you.

lines.zh: 空气开始往他掌心流
lines.en: Air starts streaming into his palm.

lines.zh: 碎石被气托到半空打转
lines.en: Debris hangs spinning in the air.

lines.zh: 他的笑容彻底消失了
lines.en: The smile is entirely gone.

lines.zh: 他前踏一步，地面塌了一块
lines.en: One step and the earth gives way.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸反而深长起来
lines.en: His breathing deepens instead.

lines.zh: 他锁定了你，不再移开视线
lines.en: Locked on, he stops looking away.

lines.zh: 他的残影提前出现了
lines.en: Afterimages show before he moves.

lines.zh: 他低声说出一个词
lines.en: He says one low word.

lines.zh: 金光把这片地照得发白
lines.en: Gold light bleaches the ground.

lines.zh: 他已经在最佳角度了
lines.en: He is already at the perfect angle.

lines.zh: 一切安静下来，只因他要动了
lines.en: All goes still because he is about to move.

lines.zh: 他一个闪身，出现在你身后
lines.en: A flicker, and he is behind you.

lines.zh: 他还站在原地，只是残影
lines.en: What stands there is only an afterimage.

lines.zh: 他的残影分成了三个
lines.en: His afterimage splits into three.

lines.zh: 每一个都朝你逼近
lines.en: Every one of them closes on you.

lines.zh: 他的速度已经超过视线
lines.en: He outruns your sight entirely.

lines.zh: 他试着点了一下你的肩
lines.en: He taps your shoulder in passing.

lines.zh: 他在测你能跟上多少
lines.en: He is measuring how much you can track.

lines.zh: 他绕着你，步伐带光
lines.en: He circles, each step trailing light.

lines.zh: 电弧在你要退的方向跳
lines.en: Arcs crackle where you would retreat.

lines.zh: 他抬手，掌心聚起一点白
lines.en: White gathers in his raised palm.

lines.zh: 他忽然停下，等你反应
lines.en: He stops short to see your answer.

lines.zh: 他笑得有点兴奋了
lines.en: His smile turns a little fierce.

lines.zh: 他把你的可能动作全数算过
lines.en: He has run every move you could make.

lines.zh: 光线在他身边弯折
lines.en: Light bends around him.

lines.zh: 他退开半步，像在邀请
lines.en: He backs half a step, as if inviting.

lines.zh: 他数着你的呼吸节奏
lines.en: He counts the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 他轻声说了句“快点”
lines.en: He mutters at you to hurry.

lines.zh: 下一步他就不会再等了
lines.en: Next moment he will stop waiting.

lines.zh: 他一拳砸下，空气爆响
lines.en: His fist crashes down with a bang.

lines.zh: 金光里他的手肘到了
lines.en: An elbow arrives out of the gold.

lines.zh: 他一脚把你踢得横飞
lines.en: A kick sends you flying sideways.

lines.zh: 拳路快得只剩一道金线
lines.en: The punch is only a gold streak.

lines.zh: 他抓住你，转半圈再甩出
lines.en: He grabs you, spins, and throws.

lines.zh: 他一掌拍在护甲最厚处
lines.en: A palm lands on your thickest plate.

lines.zh: 他连击三次，没有间隙
lines.en: Three blows without a gap.

lines.zh: 他收手时残影还在打
lines.en: The afterimage keeps striking as he stops.

lines.zh: 他借气浪加了推力
lines.en: Ki adds thrust behind the blow.

lines.zh: 他用膝顶，却收了七分力
lines.en: A knee, with most of its force held back.

lines.zh: 他打空后立刻换了角度
lines.en: The miss turns instantly into a new angle.

lines.zh: 一击落地，砸出一个坑
lines.en: A strike lands and digs a crater.

lines.zh: 他的拳头带着电弧
lines.en: Arcs ride his knuckles.

lines.zh: 他打完退开，气息未乱
lines.en: He withdraws, breathing still even.

lines.zh: 那一下只是试探的力度
lines.en: That was only testing strength.

lines.zh: 他抬手，准备再来一轮
lines.en: He lifts a hand for another round.

lines.zh: 天空被金光染成一片
lines.en: The sky washes gold.

lines.zh: 他悬在半空，气焰翻卷
lines.en: He hangs in the air, aura churning.

lines.zh: 闪电在他周围炸开
lines.en: Lightning cracks around him.

lines.zh: 他缓缓落到地面
lines.en: He descends slowly to the ground.

lines.zh: 落地时土石向外翻起
lines.en: Earth and stone curl outward as he lands.

lines.zh: 他的金发还没完全定住
lines.en: His golden hair has not quite settled.

lines.zh: 气浪把树梢全部压低
lines.en: His pressure bends every treetop.

lines.zh: 他把气焰收了一收
lines.en: He draws his aura in a notch.

lines.zh: 远处的鸟群全飞起来了
lines.en: Birds launch from the far trees.

lines.zh: 他站着，像太阳落在地上
lines.en: He stands like a sun brought to earth.

lines.zh: 他的出现让空气发热
lines.en: His arrival heats the air.

lines.zh: 他抬起眼，四下扫过
lines.en: He lifts his eyes and scans around.

lines.zh: 电弧慢慢绕着他转
lines.en: Arcs drift in a slow orbit.

lines.zh: 他伸手拂开面前的烟尘
lines.en: He waves the dust from in front of him.

lines.zh: 他轻轻落在一片空地中央
lines.en: He touches down at the centre of a clearing.

lines.zh: 他的气把草皮掀了起来
lines.en: His ki peels the turf up.

lines.zh: 他没有开口，只是等
lines.en: He says nothing, only waits.

lines.zh: 金色的影子立在光里
lines.en: A golden shadow stands in the light.

lines.zh: 火舌扑上手臂，他抖手甩开
lines.en: Fire licks his arm; he shakes it off.

lines.zh: 坠地后他撑地翻身站起
lines.en: He lands, rolls off one hand, and stands.

lines.zh: 水下他憋气，金发贴在脸上
lines.en: Beneath the water his hair plasters to his face.

lines.zh: 爆炸把他推开，气流四散
lines.en: The blast throws him back and the air scatters.

lines.zh: 箭擦过脸颊，留下一道血线
lines.en: An arrow grazes his cheek and draws blood.

lines.zh: 怪力缠上他，他低吼一声
lines.en: Strange force coils on him; he snarls once.

lines.zh: 饿着打，他的气明显弱了
lines.en: Fighting hungry, his aura is visibly thinner.

lines.zh: 雷电加身，他的电弧反而更亮
lines.en: Lightning strikes him and his own arcs blaze.

lines.zh: 虚空一拽，他爆气硬撕开
lines.en: The void tugs; he tears it open with sheer ki.
